verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows raw API endpoint URLs and an error message ('Parameter APIUser is missing') plus a sandbox URL — there is no documented call sequence for domain purchase, contact submission, or nameserver configuration via the API. No evidence demonstrates an end-to-end scriptable registration flow. Missing for 10: documented purchase/registration API call, contact-info API call, nameserver-set API call, any example of a full end-to-end automated registration.
